---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose permanent changes to orchestration policy
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
---

> **Note:** This template is for changes that could permanently affect orchestration policy. For bug fixes or minor improvements, just open a regular issue.

## Hypothesis
*What do you believe to be true?*
*What are you trying to learn?*

## Problem / Motivation
*Why does this matter for RL training or evaluation and prod alignment?*

## Experiment Design
*How would you test this?*
*What would you measure?*
*What is your success criteria?*
*How would you know if it worked?*
*What outcome would validate the hypothesis?*

## Proposed Implementation (optional)
*Rough idea of how it could work*

## Example
*Concrete scenario, sample data, or expected output*
*Do you require new data?*
